summary: The stimulus window is far too short: the current simulation runs only ~24 cycles, but the PRESENT-80 cipher requires approximately 240 cycles total (144 cycles to load the key and plaintext, ~32 cycles for the 31-round iterative encrypt schedule, plus ~64 cycles to unload/finalize). The 'done' port cannot assert before roughly cycle 240, so the vacuous pass is purely a stimulus-window limitation and NOT an RTL defect. Extend the testbench stimulus window to at least 300 cycles to allow the full 31-round iterative schedule and the final addRoundKey step to complete before sampling 'done'. Do NOT alter the datapath, shorten the round count, or make 'done' assert early — the full iterative architecture must be preserved exactly as specified.
